en: The image shows a vintage black and white postcard featuring an open square with paths and gardens, framed by prominent, ornate stone buildings. The buildings are likely governmental or institutional (e.g., post office and bank, as suggested by the Swedish text). The bottom margin contains printed text and a handwritten signature. The reverse side has handwritten address information, a Swedish stamp with 'Sverige', and postmarks, suggesting it was mailed from Sweden to Belgium in 1911.
